artifact_notes: Benchmark after_head can predate dirty implementation source; vendor source hashes identify the tested code. All accepted labels exactly match the final worktree raw bytes, and LF-normalized committed source equivalence is separately verified.

Comparator fingerprints use raw worktree bytes and Windows Path ordering. The Git archive uses LF; final committed source equivalence is additionally checked with LF normalization and the same component-wise path order, without changing sampled source files.
The pre-final CSVs use five-final-default temporary log directories after a label collision; prior tracked CSVs were restored and remain unchanged.
Four final-stage CSVs were recovered verbatim from canonical ABBA logs after output-path shadowing. The comparator was fixed; subsequent final-grid and accepted runs validated normal artifact output.
final labels are intermediate stage evidence before the later-path bounds fix; accepted labels are the final production source.

adoption.frozen_stream: adopt for reduced allocation/scratch space; not universal CPU acceleration
adoption.sparse_cells: adopt to avoid unnecessary row/column product work; business edit entities remain consumer-owned
adoption.spans: adopt explicit validated Fixed/Known rectangles; no automatic intrinsic sizing or cross-frozen-boundary span
adoption.measured_motion: adopt bounded measured short paths and separate jump-then-smooth tail; retain extra work and CPU costs
adoption.auto_and_rtl: adopt explicit constrained auto and Grid-only RTL; reject the measured per-frame generic intrinsic candidate

limits: Headless CPU/draw cycles are not GPU FPS, displayed frames or physical input latency.
No new manual screenshot, cross-GPU/DPI or Windows screen-reader certification.
Retain all adverse samples; animation is a feature cost and has different intermediate geometry/work.
Small nonzero measured endpoint errors are under the existing 0.01px workload tolerance, not exact-zero claims.
Auto tracks do not infer unobserved intrinsic maxima; only Grid has explicit RTL mirroring.
